title: Keilhauer vs Global: Office Seating Compared in Ontario
meta_description: Keilhauer or Global for your Ontario office seating? A fair, fit-based comparison of a design-led specialist and a broad-range maker, with OECM buying.
author: Steve Katz
excerpt: Keilhauer is a design-led seating specialist; Global is a broad-range manufacturer that furnishes a whole floor. Both are Canadian and we carry both, so this is a fit guide, not a ranking: when a specialist line leads, when a deep contract range serves a project better, and how an Ontario business buys either.
faq_items: Is Keilhauer better than Global for office chairs?||Neither is better in general; they are built for different jobs. Keilhauer is a design-led specialist that excels where seating is part of the design statement, while Global is a broad-range manufacturer that excels at equipping a whole floor consistently and at several price points. Most projects use both, so the useful question is which one fits a given room rather than which brand wins overall.

Is Keilhauer a Canadian company?||Yes. Keilhauer is a Canadian contract-furniture manufacturer known for design-led seating and soft seating, with a focus on craftsmanship, materials, and sustainability. For an Ontario buyer who values a home-grown maker and a design-forward catalogue, that combination is a genuine draw, and it sits alongside Global as one of the strong Canadian seating names we carry.

Do you carry both Keilhauer and Global?||Yes. We supply both lines, which is why this comparison is about fit rather than persuasion. Carrying both lets us put a design-led specialist chair where a room calls for it and a broad-range contract chair across the working floor, and keep the whole order under one plan, one delivery, and one point of contact.

Which is more affordable for equipping a team?||As a general pattern, a broad-range manufacturer like Global gives you more room to control cost across a fleet, because you can place a premium piece where it earns its keep and a well-built value chair where the job is simply all-day support. A design-led specialist line tends to sit at the considered end of the budget, which is right for showcase pieces and less efficient for filling a floor. Exact pricing depends on the chairs and quantities, so a quote is the fair comparison.

Is Global office seating good quality?||Yes. Global Furniture Group builds contract-grade seating tested to commercial standards across its range, from value task chairs to executive and lounge seating. Quality varies by model and price point as it does with any broad line, which is exactly why a verified specification and a clear warranty on the specific chair matter, and why we point buyers to a chair we can prove rather than just describe.

Can an Ontario institution buy contract seating without a tender?||Often, yes. Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner, so eligible Ontario broader-public-sector organizations such as school boards, hospitals, and municipalities can purchase contract seating through that provincial agreement, which in many cases removes the need for a separate public tender. That path applies whichever carried line a chair comes from.
